svg.title: Aegis payment flow: observe, preview, confirm, execute, verify
svg.desc: Five outlined steps. Observe a real balance, preview the amount and USD value, confirm explicitly, the contract enforces USD limits using the ETH/USD feed, then verify by contract event. The local release uses a Mock Feed.
